Compare runs

pk_compare.Rd

pk_compare() returns one row per run with OFV, the difference in OFV (dOFV), the difference in the number of estimated parameters (df), the p-value of the likelihood-ratio test, AIC, BIC, condition number, covariance step status, number of flags, and the decision. The reference is the parent of each run (ref = "parent"), the first run in the list (ref = "first"), or a given run id.

Usage

pk_compare(..., ref = c("parent", "first"), proj = NULL)

pk_compare_params(..., proj = NULL)

Arguments

...

Runs (references or ids).

ref

"parent", "first", or a run id.

proj

A pk_project object. Defaults to the current project.

Value

A tibble.

Details

The likelihood-ratio test assumes nested models; the p-value is only given for a decrease in OFV with a positive increase in the number of parameters. The OFV is only comparable between runs estimated on the same data with the same method. Runs with different data hashes or estimation methods are flagged in the column comparable.

pk_compare_params() shows the parameter estimates of several runs side by side, with the relative change against the first run.
